subject: Bridging growth credits + rollover options for Q3 expansion
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Evan Garcia <evan.garcia@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridging growth credits + rollover options for Q3 expansion

Evan —

Congrats on the hiring push. Saw your note about ramping additional agents in Q3 — great to hear Helio’s AI usage is scaling. Before we finalize numbers for the uplift, wanted to propose a short-term bridge that keeps costs predictable while you finish the headcount cadence. High level: 1) a temporary growth credit that offsets incremental token spend for 30 days, 2) an option to roll unused credit toward Nov co-term, and 3) a path to convert the uplift into a permanent committed bucket at quarter-end with a discounted band.

I attached an updated MAP (Helio-MAP-v2.xlsx) that shows three scenarios (soft-bridge, partial-commit, full-commit) with pricing and invoice timing. Quick ask — can you confirm expected % usage increase and whether procurement needs a draft SOW/PO to start the bridge? If you want, Marissa and I can walk through the scenarios this week.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Key Accounts — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Sergio —

Thanks for the quick follow. We’re forecasting roughly a 45–60% increase in token consumption over the next 6 weeks as the new support agents come online. Procurement will need a short memo and a PO to start any billing changes — they prefer a one-page commercial summary plus the quote.

Two quick constraints: 1) any temporary credit needs to be visible on the invoice (our finance ops insist), and 2) we need SOC2 evidence and the data retention appendix before they sign a PO.

Appreciate the scenarios — Evan

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Helio — bridge mechanics and discount bands (internal)

Internal —

Saw Evan’s guidance. My read: they need visibility on the invoice + SOC2. Two tactical options I’d pick from the MAP:

- Option A (soft-bridge): 30-day growth credit equal to 50% of marginal incremental spend, invoice line-item called “Q3 Bridge Credit”. No price commitment beyond 30 days.
- Option B (partial-commit): Convert 60% of projected uplift into a 3-month committed bucket at a 12% discount; unused portion rolls as credit to next invoice (visible).

Recommend offering Option B as the primary with Option A as a fallback — drives faster visibility into committed revenue while giving procurement the PO wording they need. Also ask legal to allow a one-time credit roll-forward clause.

Marissa — can you prepare a one-page commercial memo and the quote PDF? Monica — can you pull the SOC2 summary and the data retention appendix (short doc) and put them in Drive? I’ll own proposed discount bands in the quote.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Bridging growth credits + rollover options for Q3 expansion

Evan —

Attaching the one-page commercial memo and the formal quote PDF per your procurement request. Summary below:

- Chosen path: Partial-commit (recommended) — 60% of forecast uplift committed for 3 months at a 12% discount.
- Bridge credit: Remaining 40% covered by a 30-day growth credit line item (Q3 Bridge Credit) on the invoice.
- Invoice visibility: Bridge credit will appear as a separate line; rollovers will be captioned with the original PO number.
- PO language: please include: “Purchase of temporary uplift & associated bridge credit as detailed in Redwood quote HH-4829-RW.”
- SOC2 + retention: Monica attached a short SOC2 summary and the data retention appendix link.

Next steps: If procurement confirms the PO language we’ll generate final invoice schedule and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement reviewed the memo and is happy with the PO language; they requested one minor edit to the invoice captioning so the bridge credit maps to our internal cost center. I’ve looped in contracts@heliohealth.com — they’ll take the final quote and issue a PO by EOD Friday.

Two asks before we close: 1) Monica — can you confirm the SOC2 summary includes encryption-at-rest details and a contact for audit evidence? 2) Sergio — once we have the PO, can Redwood start the bridge within 48 hours? We’re ready to spin up the additional agents.

Evan
